description: Metadata-driven template for imagegen-quality player references and genuinely articulated animation pose atlases.

reproducibility.generation: The exact identity metadata, prompt, identity image, style image, chroma source, accepted RGBA source, and hashes are retained. Built-in image generation is intentionally treated as nondeterministic candidate creation.
reproducibility.compilation: Accepted RGBA sources compile byte-deterministically into the existing 64x512 runtime strips. --check recomputes every accepted source, original chroma source, identity/style input, prompt, pose, frame, and output pin.
reproducibility.promotion: One explicit identity is generated, reviewed, hash-pinned, and compiled at a time. There is no implicit bulk promotion path.

sourceAtlasLayout.frameOrder: top row left-to-right, then bottom row left-to-right

promptContract.identityAuthority: The identity portrait controls face, race, gender presentation, hair, eyes, palette, costume cues, and equipment design.
promptContract.styleAuthority: The approved full-body reference controls pixel density, outline language, compact tactical silhouette, lighting, and material rendering only.
promptContract.poseRequirement: Each atlas must redraw anatomy, limbs, hands, equipment, hair, and cloth for the requested action; rigid translation, rotation, skew, tint, or scale does not count as animation.
promptContract.layoutRequirement: Exactly eight isolated complete character poses at consistent scale, one per invisible grid cell, with no overlap and generous chroma-key gutters.
invariants: one character identity in every frame
one and only one copy of each declared equipment item
consistent costume, palette, proportions, and pixel density
no labels, text, watermark, scenery, floor, cast shadow, or grid borders

animation.sequenceAnchorPolicy: Preserve source-cell-relative root travel by default. Profiles may bottom-ground the vertical axis for contact actions such as death while retaining authored horizontal travel.

terminalRules.death: Every frame is bottom-grounded; the last two runtime frames are the same accepted fallen pose.
terminalRules.dead: All eight runtime frames are derived from and pixel-identical to the terminal death pose.
terminalRules.victory: The final frame is a held triumphant pose, never a return to neutral.

qualityGates.semanticApproval: A human review is still required for face, race/gender/class fidelity, anatomy, costume continuity, equipment count, action readability, and clean matte edges.
